The following terms used herein shall have the meanings and definitions
as hereinafter set forth:
“Zoning Resolution" shall mean the Zoning Resolution of the
City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time.
“Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights,
determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, that are appurtenant to a zoning
lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total
floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the basic maximum
allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which the zoning lot is
located; and (i) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density
and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and that may be
authorized to be developed by the New York City Planning Commission or other
appropriate agency of the City of New York.
"Reserved Development Rights" shall mean the Floor Area
Development Rights that remain appurtenant to the Owner's Premises after the removal
of the Excess Development Rights.
"Excess Development Rights" shall mean 4,400 square feet of
Floor Area Development Rights that are appurtenant to Owner's Land and are being
conveyed to Developer pursuant to this Agreement.
